fullScriptsRead.comparison: Aspect ratio, monitor size/distance, FOV, target occupancy and UI occlusion teach visibility. They do not teach walking-camera bounce, stable visual reference or player-controlled comfort options. FOV geometry overlaps and must not become a repeated central chapter.
Frame frequency, budgets, deltaTime, frame generation and input latency. Do not repeat the FPS pipeline lecture or promise that a high FPS value cures discomfort.
Character jump speed, gravity, aerial control and anticipation frames. Character movement mechanics differ from camera-motion presentation.
Opening composition directs attention and teaches the first action. Camera guidance and cause/result framing overlap only at the tool level, not the comfort question.
Full script: CPU/GPU submission, allocator reuse, fences, two slots and editor viewport lifetime; distinct from player motion comfort.
Full script: camera RenderTargets, texture descriptors, per-draw matrices, ImGui panel composition and resizing; distinct from optional player view motion.
Full script: alpha modes, PSO selection, transparent order, display SRVs and lifetime; no motion-comfort chapter.
Full script: safe rendering submission, camera textures, material modes and display composition; no comfort settings or camera-motion question.
